title: Dark Hunter Jou: Ijigen Gakuen
native_title: ダークハンター㊤ ～異次元学園～
overview:
Strike down the darkness stirring in the school! Get closer to English with a fantastic horror by Kaoru Kurimoto, Atsushi Kamijo and others.

Two transfer students appear at Jigen Academy, which high school student Mariko attends: Ran Mashita, a handsome boy with a dark side, and Cher, a tall beauty. Who are they really, with their strange behavior? Before long, Mariko too is in danger...!

"Dark Hunter" is multimedia English software created by a top-class production team. It includes the repetition practice and word reference functions essential to learning beginner English, plus an expanded set of practice exercises. It is groundbreaking software that lets you get familiar with English naturally while enjoying a thrilling story.

学園にうごめく、闇を撃て！
栗本薫、上條淳士らが手がけたファンタジックホラーで英語に急接近。

高校生・真理子の通う慈現学園に現れた2人の転校生。
陰を持つ美少年・真下蘭と長身の美女・シェール。
奇妙な行動をとる彼らの正体とは？
やがて真理子にも危機が――！

“ダークハンター”は豪華制作陣が生み出したマルチメディア英語ソフト。初級英語の学習に欠かせない反復練習や単語参照機能、さらに充実した練習問題も盛り込まれています。スリリングな物語を楽しみながら自然に英語に親しめる画期的なソフトです。
